channel.title: Aryeh Leib Toren — Writing
channel.description: Featured essays by Aryeh Leib Thorne Toren.

item.title: At the Pace of the Children: Why Yaakov Turned Down Esav's Escort
item.description: Why Yaakov turned down Esav's pace and armed escort: Rashi, the Midrash on Rabbeinu HaKadosh, and the Ramban's warning about the Hasmonean treaty with Rome, read for Vayishlach week.

item.title: Who Decides When the Threat Is "Immediate"? Vayishlach and the Caretaker Gap
item.description: Eisenkot and Netanyahu disagree on whether Iran's threat is immediate. A Vayishlach and Rambam reading of who decides on war while a government is still being formed.

item.title: A Little Light
item.description: This booklet is for Yud-Tes Kislev, Sunday, 29 November 2026 (19 Kislev 5787), and for the second day of the Rosh Hashanah of Chassidus, Monday, 30 November 2026 (20 Kislev 5787).

item.title: The Flame of Yosef
item.description: This booklet is for the week of Parshat Vayeshev in the Chabad daily cycle. It runs from Sunday, 29 November 2026 (19 Kislev 5787), Yud-Tes Kislev, when the daily Chumash opens Vayeshev, to Shabbat, 5 December 2026 (25 Kislev 5787), when the whole parsha is read in shul.

item.title: Chanukah Lighting Guide 5787
item.description: Chanukah 2026: first candle Friday 4 December (evening) · eighth candle Friday 11 December (evening)

item.title: Chanukah Kids' Table
item.description: Chanukah 5787 · First candle Friday 4 December 2026 · Eighth candle Friday 11 December 2026

item.title: Both Fears
item.description: Rashi, from the Midrash, explains the two words: he was afraid he would be killed, and distressed that he might have to kill.

item.title: Whole on the Road: Vayishlach Week
item.description: A 127-page booklet for Vayishlach week, 22 to 28 November 2026: the parsha an aliyah a day, the Ovadiah haftarah, the Chitas, the Rambam and Yud-Tes Kislev.

item.title: Guarded on the Way
item.description: The haftarah of Vayetze as read in Chabad shuls, Hoshea 11:7 to 12:14, with Rashi, and Psalm 121 with the Midrash that opens the parsha. A 21-page printable.

item.title: Tehillim 55: Padah Veshalom
item.description: A study book on Tehillim 55, the psalm of betrayal and trust, and its verse “He redeemed my soul in peace,” tied to the Mitteler Rebbe’s release on Yud Kislev.

item.title: Tehillim 51: Chaneini, the Psalm of Teshuvah
item.description: A study booklet on Tehillim 51, the psalm of teshuvah, with Rashi, Radak, the Malbim and the Midrash, the Rambam on teshuvah and the Tanya on the broken heart.

item.title: The Field and the House
item.description: Toldot ends with a father blessing a son by the smell of a field. Vayetze opens with that son asleep on a stone, waking to say he is standing in a house. The walk between them turns on two words: field and house.

item.title: Wherefore Do I Live?
item.description: This Shabbat's portion begins with a prayer that is answered, and the answer hurts. Rivka asks, 'If it be so, wherefore do I live?' and takes the question to the school of Shem.

item.title: Hear, My People: Psalm 81 and the Blind Father
item.description: Psalm 81, the Thursday psalm, meets Yitzchak in the tent in the week of Toldot: one sense, hearing. A 4-page study.

item.title: The Garments of Esav, the Voice of Yaakov
item.description: Toldot: Yitzchak smells the garments. Bogdav, Rashi on the scent of Gan Eden, and the voice of Yaakov, a 5-page study.

item.title: The Voice and the Hands
item.description: The voice of Yaakov and the hands of Esau: Toldot, Rashi and the Hayom Yom for 2 Kislev, an 8-page essay.

item.title: Not to Another Place
item.description: Iran's uranium, and a Rambam ruling on goods that leave your hand: a 5-page essay.

item.title: Wells, Witnesses and Heirs: An Expanded Edition
item.description: A second, expanded edition of Wells, Witnesses and Heirs: the introduction and Chapter Four, Wells by Their Old Names.

item.title: We Have Surely Seen: Covenant, Memory and Partnership
item.description: A study booklet on the treaty at Beersheba: the introduction and Chapter Three, on what both sides had seen.

item.title: Tehillim 144: Who Trains My Hands
item.description: A study booklet on Tehillim 144: the introduction and Chapter One, on hands that were taught to fight.
